patientControl.caseTruth: Existing ontology, structured/canonical history, nine-state facts, conflict quarantine, and answer planner remain authoritative.
patientControl.disclosurePolicy: Question-triggered release with exact, approximate, partial, patient-unknown, withheld, and conflict handling.
patientControl.personaStyle: Fact-free tone, anxiety, language level, response length, cooperation, and memory clarity; it cannot change Case Truth.
patientControl.studentVisibility: Patient control internals and response error categories are developer-only.

measurementDataAgent.flow: student action -> canonical action -> exact case result -> release condition -> provenance -> timeline/evidence graph
measurementDataAgent.boundary: Patient Agent never releases physical examination, laboratory, imaging, or pathology results; critical results are never generated by the LLM.

evidenceGraph.storage: Lightweight nodes inside signed attempt state and the existing SQLite JSON state; no graph database.
evidenceGraph.studentProjection: Only stage-safe evidenceId, stage, and label are exposed; unreleased results, rubric mappings, provenance internals, and hidden answers are not exposed.

stages.stage2: Per-order Data Agent results retain configured provenance and prerequisites; timeline sanitization excludes undefined and raw objects.
stages.stage3: Diagnosis builder accepts primary and up to three differential diagnoses, with server-issued evidence IDs for support/opposition and selected follow-up tests.
stages.stage4: Urology self-consult is excluded; each external consult carries purpose, question, and validated evidence IDs, followed by case-related value/necessity/integration feedback.
stages.stage5: Order-style treatment workbench keeps medication facts learner-entered and evaluates emergency/admission, medication, tests, procedures, intervention, monitoring, contraindication, and follow-up actions.
stages.stage6: Structured perioperative checklist covers indication through follow-up and returns hits, omissions, risks, and case reference points.
stages.stage7: Final report includes questions, acquired evidence, examinations/orders, diagnosis formation, consultation, treatment, perioperative management, decision transitions, and omissions. Percentage remains primary; 360-point evidence detail remains available.
stages.feedbackEvidence: All 109 evaluated stage 3-7 feedback items referenced one or more IDs present in the authoritative attempt evidence graph.

models.selection: Qwen3-1.7B Q4 remains default because Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M produced no accuracy, error, context, or fallback improvement while increasing latency and peak memory.
models.safeFallbackReason: The one fallback in each model was local_metadata_conflict_with_governed_candidates and was reported as rule_fallback, never local_ai.
